sloka: किं भवन्तस्समस्ताश्च मतङ्गवनवासिनः ।मत्समीपमनुप्राप्ता अपि स्वस्ति वनौकसाम् ॥४-११-६०॥।।
transliteration: kiṁ bhavantassamastāśca mataṅgavanavāsinaḥ ।matsamīpamanuprāptā api svasti vanaukasām ॥4-11-60॥।।

translations.english: 'Why have you, residents of the groves of Matanga, come to me? Hope all are safe'
